nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the Go rendezvous broker, compiling a static CGO-free binary and packaging it into a distroless nonroot image exposing port 8080. Built from the repo root and deployed on Railway.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-stage build: a golang:1.26 builder stage produces a trimmed static binary that is copied into a distroless/static-debian12:nonroot runtime for a minimal, non-root attack surface.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builder stage on golang:1.26 that downloads modules and compiles the broker into a static, stripped binary at /broker.

nodes.name: static-debian12
nodes.summary: Runtime stage on distroless/static-debian12:nonroot that copies the compiled broker binary, exposes port 8080, and runs it as the entrypoint.
